coverage: Super-repo only (/home/avi/documents/work/substrate), git log 2026-07-01 -> 2026-09-28: 2031 commits (Jul 306, Aug 924, Sep 801). Read every subject. Read about 150 commit bodies, grouped by cluster: pull-sync/mirror, federation/relay, self-recovery, secrets/auth, human-surface, trace-store, selection/learning audits, minting, residue commits, docs/openspec pruning, the 09-25..09-28 check-ins. Ran git log -S on recurring identifiers (content_hash, Requires=, HOST=127.0.0.1, MemoryMax, TRACE_RETENTION, NO_RESERVATION, RESTART_DEFER, QUIESCE_WAIT, learning-mode-state, git add -A). Counted residue files at HEAD, per autonomous commit. Took a file census of validation/scripts and openspec/changes. Submodule-internal history was not read; it is seen only through bump subjects and report check-ins, and vessel hashes are labelled as such. Pre-07-01 belongs to git-super-1. One report, WHY-THINGS-KEEP-BREAKING-2026-09-28.md (commits 2ca586ba/40fff5db), was read as commit-level evidence. Nothing was edited except the output file.

principles: Fixes are site-scoped and validated once; nothing re-checks the class (bd1fb6d9, 09-28)
Every change is validated locally and once; humans are the detector. 247 of 253 break cases were operator-found (2ca586ba)
A marker recording a git sha can lie about a tree it does not describe; compare content (596fd717)
A loud failure nobody queries is a silent one (4e79dd76)
Repeating a deterministic failure is not persistence, it is a refusal to conclude (ad9da780)
A check cannot be scheduled by the mechanism it recovers (bootstrap-tier exception) (b2ff657b)
Measure the machine you deploy to: 'the cap WAS the OOM' (9df01220)
A green check on the working tree says nothing about what was committed (e92d2e1b)
Querying a masked unit returns defaults, not its settings (e2ba1a69)
A close must close something; close rates inflate in the flattering direction (015b31fa)
Everything must be available over p2p; bespoke HTTP is unavailable to a federated peer by construction (3b4f921a)
A doc asserting operational structure is a cache; measurements in docs repeat the defect in a new costume (72f58abc, 3c113703)
Advertised is a claim, demonstrated is a fact (d4b7421e)
A configuration mistake is the one class the system cannot self-correct (28f78545)
Do not deduplicate identical failures; recurrence must stay arithmetically visible (a172e235)
A fix present in repo and build but absent from behaviour is a propagation question (33924f92)
Basename grep is not caller evidence; the watchdog duplicate came from '| head -15' (8d3e57ce, bb217e5e)
Instruments must live outside the subject they measure (e4fe46d1)
Pre-register criteria and falsifiers before dispatching (efad388f, a5723cef, 837cfe0e)
